items.title: Russian hybrid attacks against Europe intensifying, says Macron
items.description: The French president says he has tasked the government with protecting critical infrastructure and defence industry sites.

items.title: Russia votes for new parliament in controlled elections
items.description: Russia is holding its first State Duma election since invading Ukraine, with voting also imposed in occupied Ukrainian regions. President Vladimir Putin's party is expected to dominate the tightly controlled contest.

items.title: Canada and EU: A look at the bloc's special relationships
items.description: Though Canada may be some distance from Europe geographically, closer political ties are in the cards. With talk of an associate membership, DW takes a look at other arrangements the EU has with particular countries.

items.title: US and Denmark reach deal over Greenland after Trump annexation threats
items.description: Denmark and Greenland have welcomed the deal, which Trump claims will give the US "permanent control over security and all other needs" in the Danish territory.

items.title: Trump says he is banning CNN and Politico from White House
